name: bp-wa-bridge
description: BP WhatsApp Web reader bridge — reads the owner's two WhatsApp Web sessions and posts batched conversations to n8n. Reads only, except the opt-in owner-commanded outbox (outbox.mjs, off by default).

scripts.check: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/session.mjs && node --check src/post.mjs && node --check src/normalize.mjs && node --check src/backfill.mjs && node --check src/log.mjs && node --check src/outbox.mjs && npm run guard
